 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE S. B. PD. SINGH
ORAL ORDER 3 07-11-2025 Heard learned counsel for the petitioner as well as learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the State.
2. The petitioner is apprehending his arrest in connection with Complaint Case No. 693C of 2022 registered for the offence punishable under Sections 406, 420 of the Indian Penal Code.
3. As per the prosecution case, the petitioners defrauded and took Rs. 3,91,000/- from the complainant on the pretext of selling land.

4. Learned counsel for the petitioner has submitted that the petitioners are innocent and have committed no offence Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.49996 of 2025(3) dt.07-11-2025 and have falsely been implicated in this case.
The present case is absolutely false.
The petitioners never approached the complainant (Opposite Party No. 2) for selling their land.
He did not receive any single penny from the complainant.
The document mentioned in complaints petition are fake and copy of it has not been supplied with certified copy of complaint petition.
In the year 2021 on 15 th June, the Opposite Party No. 2 attempted to construct a shade for showing title, and on protest they threatened.
144 Cr.P.C. proceeding was initiated between the parties and the proceeding was converted into 145 Cr.P.C. vide Misc. Case No. 434 of 2021.

6. Considering the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case, let the above named petitioners, in the event of his arrest/surrender within a period of six weeks from today, be enlarged on anticipatory bail on furnishing bail-bond of Rs. 10,000/- (Rupees ten thousand) with two sureties of the like Patna High Court CR.
